messages:
Jon: hey all, first day here. I used jon.l@redwood.com but Okta shows me as jon.l+contractor@redwood.com and I can't see the "Developer" app. also 1Password says my seat was transferred to someone else? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Jon! Provisioning kicked off. Snapshot: Google account created (alias detected), Okta user exists, group sync pending, 1Password seat pending reconciliation.
Aisha (IT): hi @Jon  can you paste the exact address shown in Okta profile? also which email did you sign up with on the hiring form?
Jon: hiring form had jon.l@redwood.com. Okta profile shows primary: jon.l+contractor@redwood.com and recovery: jon.l@redwood.com. Dashboard lists no apps.
Aisha (IT): thanks. looks like an alias normalization mismatch from HR import. I'll reassign primary to jon.l@redwood.com and re-run group provisioning.
Aisha (IT): running: `/admin/users/merge?primary=jon.l@redwood.com&alias=jon.l+contractor@redwood.com` -> queued job 44c2. Triggering groupsync and 1Password reconciliation after merge.
DevSec: note: merging aliases may temporarily remove device trust records. We will re-enroll device trust after merge if needed.
Sam (People Ops): pinging HR to confirm the onboarding form used the right email. Also checking 1Password license movements  sometimes seats get auto-assigned to contractors and need manual reassign when full-time.
Jon: ok thanks. I can see the merge job status: queued. Any ETA?
Aisha (IT): should finish in 2-3 minutes. Ill post when groupsync completes.
Aisha (IT): merge finished. re-running: `/internal/syncs/groups?user=jon.l@redwood.com&force=true` -> groupsync job id b9e1.
Aisha (IT): groupsync done. you should now see the Developer app in Okta. Please log out and back in.
Jon: I logged in, Developer app visible now :thumbsup: but 1Password still shows no seat.
Sam (People Ops): I see a seat was reclaimed and assigned to contractor group. I flipped the license back to the engineering pool and invited you manually. Invite ID: INV-777.
Jon: got the invite, setting up 1Password now.
DevSec: device trust recheck: when you enroll your passkey, let us know and we will retire any stale U2F keys. Also expect a Jamf enrollment email for device management.
Jon: passkey registration worked, jamf email arrived. all set. thanks everyone! :v:
Onboarding Bot: Provisioning complete: Okta apps visible, Drive and 1Password access active, Jamf enrollment pending final check. Ticket will auto-close in 1h if no activity.
